title: Śrī Śrī Prabhupād-padma Stavaka
author: Sanskrit composition to Śrīla Prabhupād (Bhagavān Śrīla Bhakti Siddhānta Saraswatī Ṭhākur) by Śrīla Bhakti Rakṣak Śrīdhar Dev-Goswāmī Mahārāj
subtitle: Prayer unto the Lotus Feet of my Lord and Master

translation: His lotus feet are served in devotion by multitudes of high, virtuous souls; he is the establisher of the religion of the age as he is the presiding monarch of the Viśva Vaiṣṇava Rāja Sabhā – the universal society of the pure devotees that are the true ‘kings’ or guides of all; and he is the fulfiller of the most cherished desires of those who dispel fear (for all souls). I offer my obeisances unto the lotus feet of that illustrious great soul, worshipable by one and all – perpetually do I offer my obeisances unto the radiance emanating from the toenails of the holy feet of my Lord.

He is the leader of the fortunate souls blessed with the treasure of internal pure devotion; he is greatly merciful upon the fallen souls, being their only shelter; and his inconceivable holy feet are the shelter for the deceivers, by deceiving them. I offer my obeisances unto his lotus feet – perpetually do I offer my obeisances unto the radiance emanating from the toenails of the holy feet of my Lord.

I offer my obeisances unto his divine, charming yet commanding lofty form of golden hue. That beautiful figure shames the mad ecstasy of golden lotus stems. Venerated by tens of millions of Cupids, the moons of the toenails of my Worshipful Divine Master reveal the beauty of his lotus feet. Perpetually do I offer my obeisances unto that effulgence emanating from the toenails of the holy feet of my Lord.

Like the moon that delights the stars, he is surrounded by his circle of personal servitors, making their hearts bloom in divine ecstasy. The malicious non-devotees are made to flee in panic by the sound of his thunderous roar, and the simple, inoffensive souls attain the ultimate fortune by accepting his lotus feet. I offer my obeisances unto him; perpetually do I offer my obeisances unto the brilliance emanating from the toenails of the holy lotus feet of my Lord.

He has revealed the vast, magnificent beauty of Śrī Gaura Dhām; he has broadcast the tidings of the supreme magnanimity of Śrī Gaurāṅga throughout the whole universe; and in the hearts of the fit recipients of his grace, he has firmly established the lotus feet of Śrī Gaura. I offer my obeisances unto him; perpetually do I offer my obeisances unto the effulgence emanating from the toenails of the holy feet of my Lord.

He is the eternal shelter and the Universal Guru for the souls surrendered unto Śrī Gaurāṅga. Absorbed in the service of his Gurudev, Śrī Gaura Kiśor, he wholeheartedly adores Śrī Bhakti Vinod Ṭhākur. I offer my obeisances unto him; perpetually do I offer my obeisances unto the effulgence emanating from the toenails of the holy feet of my Lord.

He is the illustrious personality to raise the flag that sings the glories of Śrī Rūpa, Śrī Sanātan, and Śrī Raghunāth. His glories are sung throughout the world as non-different from the powerful personality of brilliant erudition, Śrī Jīva. And he has won the renown of being one with the hearts of Śrīla Kṛṣṇa Dās Kavirāj and Ṭhākur Narottam. I offer my obeisances unto him; perpetually do I bow down to the brilliance emanating from the toenails of the holy feet of my Lord.

Bestowing his grace upon all souls, he is Hari-kīrtan incarnate. As the associate of Śrī Gaura, he relieves Mother Earth of the burden of offences committed upon her. And he is so gracious that his endearance of all beings excels that of even a father. I offer my obeisances unto him – the mine of all these qualities; perpetually do I bow down to the effulgence emanating from the toenails of the holy feet of my Lord.

Like a wish-fulfilling tree for his surrendered servitors (he fulfils their heart’s aspirations), even a tree is shamed by his magnanimity and forbearance. And great personalities who are competent to confer boons – they, too, worship his lotus feet. I offer my obeisances unto him; perpetually do I bow down to the radiance emanating from the toenails of the holy feet of my Lord.

The crown-jewel of the paramahaṁsas, the Prince of the treasure of the supreme perfection of life, Śrī Kṛṣṇa-prema, he accepted the robes of a mendicant sannyāsī just to deliver the fallen souls. The topmost tridaṇḍī sannyāsīs attend his lotus feet. I offer my obeisances unto him; perpetually do I bow down to the effulgence emanating from the toenails of the holy feet of my Lord.

He is the dearmost intimate follower of the Divine Daughter of Śrī Vṛṣabhānu, and I know myself as the most fortunate by taking the dust of his holy feet upon my head. I offer my obeisances unto his invincible, wondrously purifying lotus feet – perpetually do I bow to the brilliance emanating from the toenails of the holy feet of my Lord.
